desc.x: GAFFLOW DEEP CAST EPOXY RESIN, 14.5kg kit

This isn’t just any resin… this is GAFFLOW Deep Cast Epoxy. Specifically engineered for deep, crystal-clear pours in one hit, delivering that mirror-gloss, water-clear finish every serious installer, artist, and craftsman demands.

It’s ideal for resin river tables, wood/resin projects, flower preservation and encapsulation. It has good UV resistance, clarity and transparency making the resin system suitable for just about any deep creative project.

FEATURES & BENEFITS, UV Resistance: River tables and thick application products are often exposed to natural or artificial light. Advanced UV blockers offer exceptional UV resistance, keeping your projects looking fresh, no yellowing, no compromise.

- Low Viscosity: Casting resin has a lower viscosity than regular epoxy resins, allowing an easy flow. Being able to pour and fill moulds with ease and evenly, reduced the incidence of air bubbles, providing a superior finish.

- Low Exothermic Reaction: Formulated to generate minimal heat during curing, this deep-casting epoxy features an extended working time, allowing pours of up to 15kg or 50mm thickness (whichever is reached first) in a single application. This helps prevent excessive exothermic build-up and reduces the risk of shrinkage after curing.

- Bubble Release: Designed for superior clarity, this resin features low surface tension that promotes efficient bubble release, helping you achieve a flawless, glass-like finish in river table applications.
- Clear and Transparent Finish
- Moulding and De-moulding Ease: The resin should release easily from the mould after curing.

Coverage: At a 50mm pour depth, a 14.5kg kit provides coverage of approximately 0.26m² , making it ideal for smaller river table pours or deep casting projects. We recommend allowing extra material for waste and absorption.

Gafflow Metallic powder epoxy pigments add striking depth and decorative effects to epoxy coatings. These pigments can totally transform surfaces with stunning visual results. Available in either 300g or 50g sizes.

Unlike standard liquid epoxy pigments, the lightweight powder is specifically designed to evenly suspend within the epoxy resin, ensuring a well-balanced and consistent mixture. Powder epoxy pigments offer excellent corrosion, chemical, and abrasion resistance, along with flexibility and adhesion, enhancing the overall performance of coating applications.
Please note, these are not suitable for outdoor use, as exposure to ultraviolet radiation can cause chalking.
These pigments are widely used by epoxy floor installation professionals across the UK.
